flacmn.summary: Manages your digital music library: analyses each album’s quality, fixes tags and cover art, and sends your music to the flacmn phone app in the format you choose.

search.title: Search your tags
search.caption: One box searches artist, album, song, genre and label across the whole library.

quality.title: Check the real quality
quality.caption: Each track's spectrum is measured. A FLAC made from an MP3 or AAC shows its cutoff and is flagged as a lossy source.

tags.title: Fix tags and covers
tags.caption: Tags are checked against MusicBrainz and missing covers come from the Cover Art Archive, only when you ask.

send.title: Send it to your phone
send.caption: Pair the phone with a code over Wi-Fi, then send albums as the original, FLAC, ALAC, AAC or MP3, with every size shown first.

play.title: Play it on the phone
play.caption: The phone app plays it with its quality shown, and swipes to an XY scope in the cover's colour.

pivmn.summary: A desktop app or CLI tool for particle image velocimetry: turns DaVis projects or image pairs into velocity fields, planar or stereo, on your CPU or GPU.

source.title: Choose the input
source.caption: A DaVis .set project, a folder of .set files to run as a batch, or a folder of image pairs in .im7, TIFF or PNG.

mode.title: Pick planar or stereo, CPU or GPU
mode.caption: Both modes run on either backend. The CPU backend works on any computer; the GPU one needs an NVIDIA card with CUDA.

setup.title: Set units, output and calibration
setup.caption: Calibration is read straight from the project's own Calibration.xml, and stereo viewing angles are worked out at every correlation point.

tune.title: Tune the passes and filters
tune.caption: Set the multi-pass window schedule, then the filters that reject spurious vectors and fill and smooth the field.

preview.title: Preview the first pair
preview.caption: Check the result on one pair before committing to the whole batch.

run.title: Run the batch
run.caption: The batch runs in the background, and the results can be plotted as vector fields.

phdmn.summary: PhD research in experimental fluid mechanics: turbulence from a random jet array, porous disk settling, and machine-learning control of the tank.
